symptom: ako/mxcli#2015 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1775): `drop user role Administrator` on a fresh app passed check, exec and `mx check` (0 errors), and every build then failed with System.NullReferenceException in Mendix.Modeler.Deployment.CoreMetadataWriter.WriteMetadataProperties; MDL could neither set nor print Security$ProjectSecurity.AdminUserRole.
cause: AdminUserRole stores the role by NAME; execDropUserRole removed the role without looking at it, and mx check does not resolve the name (an empty one is CE0130, a dangling one is unchecked), so the first thing to notice was mxbuild's metadata writer.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_security_write.go (execDropUserRole refuses ps.AdminUserRole; alter app security AdminUserRole via resolveUserRole), mdl/executor/validate_grant_refs.go (check predicts the refusal, following an AdminUserRole set earlier in the script), mdl/visitor/visitor_security.go (AdminUserRole key), mdl/backend SetProjectAdminUserRole, mdl/executor/cmd_security.go (Admin User Role printed)
insight: A name-keyed reference that mx check does not resolve is only proven by a build: measured on 11.12.6 with mxbuild --target=package — the old mxcli's drop gives mx check 0 errors and the NullReferenceException; alter AdminUserRole then drop gives mx check 0 errors and BUILD SUCCEEDED. The refusal must live in exec, not only check, so `exec --no-check` cannot write the crash either. Same class as `drop user role` not following other inbound references (demo users: CE1613, still accepted).
